events.verdict: Thompson (CLE) makes contact to the head of Hart (LAL) during his driving shot attempt and affects his ability to defend.
Thompson (CLE) makes contact to the body of Kuzma (LAL) after the release that affects his jump shot attempt.
Osman (CLE) firms up and sets the pick on Ball (LAL) without delivering contact.
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) makes marginal contact to the arm of Sexton (CLE) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Thompson (CLE) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Kuzma (LAL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Osman (CLE) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ball (LAL) and does not deliver contact.
Ingram (LAL) makes contact to the body of Sexton (CLE) during the drive but the contact is marginal.
Thompson (CLE) briefly grasps Kuzma's (LAL) arm during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Ball (LAL) commits a take foul on Thompson (CLE).
[Observable in enhanced video] Ball (LAL) steps inside the three-point arc before the release of the free throw.
Osman (CLE) makes contact with Kuzma's (LAL) arm during the start of the drive but it does not affect his SQBR.
Kuzma (LAL) makes some contact with Thompson's (CLE) back during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Hart (LAL) commits a take foul on Osman (CLE).
Chandler (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Hood (CLE) and slightly extends his arm against Hood (CLE) but he is able to move through contact.
Hood (CLE) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Caldwell-Pope (LAL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Kuzma (LAL) makes some contact with Osman's (CLE) back during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
RLS shows Osman (CLE) legally contests Kuzma's (LAL) shot and does not take away his landing area. Kuzma extends his legs out in front of him to create contact on the jump shot.
Kuzma (LAL) engages with Hood (CLE) during the screen and it affects his FOM.
Clarkson (CLE) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Hart (LAL) and firms up without delivering contact.
Clarkson (CLE) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) commits a take foul on Burks (CLE).
Hood (CLE) makes contact to the body of Caldwell-Pope (LAL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
LLS shows Hart (LAL) makes contact with Burks's (CLE) head during the rebound and affects his ability to retrieve the ball.
Ball (LAL) commits a take foul on Hood (CLE).
Thompson (CLE) makes contact with Kuzma's (LAL) arm during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Kuzma (LAL) commits a take foul on Burks (CLE).
